CORE COMPETENCIES
Enterprise Data Platform Delivery | BI & Analytics Program Management | Data Warehouse & Service Management
Agile & Hybrid Delivery (Scrum/Waterfall) | Platform Modernization & Cloud Migration
Multi-Vendor Management — Singapore, Lebanon, India, Egypt (Oman-based) | Delivery Governance & SLA Management
Tools: Teradata, Informatica, Power BI, Tableau, MicroStrategy, Cloudera, Control-M, Knime, Power Automate, ChatGPT, Claude

raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Technical Project Manager – Holiday Campaign & Data Delivery (Client: Walmart)
Deloitte USI (Payroll: HNC) | Bengaluru, India | Feb 2026 – Jul 2026
Managed delivery governance for Walmart's $250M+ Holiday campaign portfolio across Printed Catalogs, Walmart.com, TV/OLV, Digital, CRM, and omnichannel channels.
Led cross-functional delivery across Marketing, Merchandising, Creative, Media, Analytics, and Technology teams, managing milestones, RAID, dependencies, approvals, and executive review cycles.
Partnered with business, analytics, and data engineering teams to drive data readiness, executive dashboards, and KPI reporting across Data Warehouse and Data Mart platforms — empowering leadership with trusted, timely insights across the Holiday campaign lifecycle.
Managed delivery dependencies and execution risks, aligning technology and business stakeholders around campaign objectives.
Supported AI-enabled workflow automation initiatives by driving business requirement alignment, UAT coordination, stakeholder readiness, and adoption across Holiday campaign operations.
Technical Project Manager – BI & Enterprise Data Platforms
Ooredoo Oman (Payroll: System Sokware LLC) | Muscat, Oman | Aug 2022 – Aug 2025
Directed end-to-end delivery across Enterprise Data Platforms, BI Agile programs, Smart Network Planning, Campaign Analytics, Data Warehouse Operations, and Data Lake modernization initiatives, leading a 21-member cross-functional team (including 3 interns).
Established delivery governance frameworks covering scope control, risk management, vendor sourcing — RFP evaluation and contract governance — and executive reporting across multiple concurrent programs.
Functioned as Service Delivery Lead for enterprise BI & DWH platforms, owning SLA governance, service reliability, stakeholder engagement, and multi-vendor delivery assurance across Singapore, Lebanon, India, and Egypt.
Enterprise BI & Data Warehouse
Led Agile BI delivery through sprint governance, backlog prioritization, and dependency management; delivered BI modernization using Power BI and Tableau, reducing decision turnaround by ~50%.
Oversaw 16×7 DWH operations, driving SLA adherence, ETL stability, and performance optimization — improving ETL processing efficiency by 36% through workflow optimization and automation.
Resolved cross-functional delivery dependencies and championed SLA governance, recovery planning, and data quality frameworks, improving business continuity and reporting accuracy.
Smart Network Planning (SNP – Waterfall)
Owned delivery management for a $1M network forecasting and investment planning platform, coordinating multi-vendor delivery across Singapore and Lebanon for long-term capacity and CAPEX decisions.
Campaign Management & CVM Analytics
Enabled Flytxt-driven marketing and CVM campaigns by ensuring upstream data availability, Data Warehouse readiness, and analytics support, enabling business teams to measure campaign effectiveness and ROI.
Platform Administration & Migration
Owned enterprise BI and Data Platform delivery covering MicroStrategy, Informatica, Cloudera, and Teradata ecosystems, driving re-platforming, migration planning, vendor coordination, and post-implementation stabilization.
Drove Data Platform Roadmap / Transformation Roadmap planning, aligning BI and analytics initiatives with enterprise digital transformation strategy.
Led the migration from Cloudera to open-source/Ligadata platforms, managing CAB approvals, release coordination, vendor transition, and post-migration stabilization; led IDQ implementation.
Technical Lead / Offshore Delivery Lead – Data Platforms
HSBC (UK Region), via Synechron Technologies | Pune, India | Aug 2020 – Jul 2022
Assumed Project Management responsibilities during COVID for a 10-member team, representing the Data Platform function in Scrum ceremonies while ensuring delivery continuity, workload planning, and stakeholder alignment.
Managed major and minor Teradata platform upgrades for the UK and Hong Kong regions, coordinating global teams, release planning, change governance, and production readiness.
Initiated the enterprise transformation program to decommission legacy Teradata platforms and transition to Google Cloud Platform (GCP), supporting roadmap planning, dependency assessment, and migration strategy.
Coordinated geographically distributed teams across the UK, Hong Kong, and India, ensuring seamless execution of platform upgrades, operational readiness, and delivery commitments.
Senior Software Engineer – BI & Data Platforms
Sears Holdings India | Pune, India | Jul 2012 – Aug 2020
Spent 4 years as Data Warehouse Developer building and supporting ETL and reporting pipelines, then 4 years as Teradata DBA owning database administration, performance tuning, and production stability for enterprise BI and analytics platforms across large-scale retail operations.
Delivered development, database administration, and production support for Teradata, Informatica, Control-M, Tableau, and Power BI, while supporting the migration from Teradata to Teradata Vantage on AWS, including platform readiness, operational transition, and stabilization.
Supported enterprise Data Warehouse solutions for Barclays and Citi credit card applications, enabling customer analytics, regulatory reporting, and business intelligence.
